messages:
jordan_user: Hi — signed up via Google SSO a few minutes ago, verified email, tried adding card (3DS failed first time but I retried and it went through). I expected the free trial credits but balance shows 0. Can you check?

support-bot: New support ticket created #SUP-87421 — routing to @alex_support :wave:

alex_support: hey jordan — sorry about that. Can you DM your account email or paste your account ID here? Also which region did you pick during signup?

jordan_user: sure — account email is jordan+redwoodtest@gmail.com, account_id: acct_01G7X2ABCD. Region I briefly clicked EU then switched to us-west before finishing payment (I remember seeing EU in the SSO redirect).

alex_support: thanks. quick triage: can you confirm the last4 of the card and whether the 3DS showed ‘challenge completed’? if you have any 3DS reference id from your bank that helps.

jordan_user: card ends 4242, bank popup said “authentication successful” on retry. no obvious 3ds id in the popup, but the payment page returned: `payment_intent.status=requires_capture -> succeeded` and I got a receipt from Stripe.

alex_support: copying in @maria_billing to check the gating rules. initial thought: we have a known race where SSO redirect region param + payment method verification can leave the trial gating in pending state (internal note). maria — can you confirm if acct_01G7X2ABCD is flagged for manual review or fraud hold?

maria_billing: looking now. stripe_charge_id shows ch_3KXXXX, 3DS result = `success`. However account has `trial_gate = manual_review` flagged and `region_hint=EU` while billing_region=US. That mismatch seems to trigger our review flow which blocked auto-grant. I can manually apply the free-trial credits if we confirm no fraud.

alex_support: thanks. jordan — did you use any VPN or have billing address outside US? any mismatch in billing zip vs Google account?

jordan_user: no VPN. Billing zip matches my card (94107). I clicked region by mistake during SSO — definitely selected EU then quickly switched. I can share logs if needed.

maria_billing: ok — since charge succeeded and 3DS passed, I'll do a manual grant now and remove the manual_review flag. Applying 1000 trial tokens. This will take ~1–2 minutes to propagate.

support-bot: Billing action: manual trial grant issued by maria_billing for acct_01G7X2ABCD (SUP-87421).

maria_billing: done — I applied credits (1000 free credits). Please check your account balance. Also filed a follow-up with eng to address the SSO region redirect + payment race (internal task INF-1293).

jordan_user: I can see the credits now, thanks so much! :tada: One small ask — is there anything I need to do to avoid this in future?

alex_support: glad it worked. For now avoid changing region mid-signup; we're pushing a fix to ensure region_hint is normalized from SSO before payment completion. We'll follow up once INF-1293 has a patch.

maria_billing: marking ticket as resolved from billing side. If anything flips back, re-open and ping us.

jordan_user: all good, closing on my side too. thanks!

support-bot: Ticket SUP-87421 closed (resolution: manual trial grant applied).
